events.title: UMB Financial Q1 Earnings Beat on Y/Y Rise in NII, Expenses Fall
events.body: UMBF tops Q1 EPS estimates as NII and revenues surge y/y, fueled by loan growth, margin expansion and Heartland acquisition impacts.

events.title: Texas Capital Q1 Earnings Beat on Strong NII & Fee Income, Cost Up Y/Y
events.body: TCBI beats Q1 earnings estimates on strong NII, fee income growth, and rising loans and deposits despite higher expenses and credit costs.

events.title: COLB Q1 Earnings Beat on Y/Y Rise in NII & Fee Income
events.body: Columbia Banking System tops on Q1 earnings as revenues rise on NII growth, though mounting expenses, provisions and weaker credit metrics temper the upside.

events.title: Huntington Stock Gains as Q1 Earnings Top on Higher NII & Fee Income
events.body: HBAN stock rises after Q1 earnings beat as higher NII and fee income drive growth, despite rising expenses, higher provisions and weaker credit quality.
